messages:
maria-cs: Heads-up — AegisSoft dedicated pool bring-up is scheduled Thu 03:00 UTC. Need final quota signoff, autoscale policy, and the approved load test script. Renewal is tentatively on hold until throughput and SLOs are validated. Who's owning each piece?
liam-sre: On it. What's the target steady/peak and the canary cadence? Also need instance types and expected burst pattern to tune autoscale.
maria-cs: Target steady ~250 req/s during the primary window, with short bursts to 600 rps. Canary plan: 10% → 50% → 100% over 30m (step every 10m). Instances: start 4x A10G (pool-5f3a), can scale to 8 if needed.
devon-ml: Recommend autoscale rule: add 1 GPU when util >= 75% for 120s, cooldown 300s. KV cache warmup mandatory 15m before traffic. Latency SLO: p95 < 350ms at seq_len=1024; error rate < 0.5%.
anya-se: I can draft the runbook and rollback criteria. Will drop first pass by Wed EOD.
kapil-eng: Provisioning in staging now — will mirror to prod once runbook is final.
capacity-bot: Pool aegis-prod-dedicated created (id: pool-5f3a) — staging validation passed.
liam-sre: For load tool use `ramp_runner`. Snippet to follow: 
```bash
ramp_runner --target 250 --peak 600 --duration 60m --seq-len 1024 --kv-warmup 15m
```
Add header sampling and token-rate limits to mimic real traffic patterns.
maria-cs: FYI finance said renewal flips green if we hit latency & error SLOs for 7 days post-rollout, but we'll aim for a 48h soak after full shift to be conservative.
anya-se: Draft rollback triggers: sustained error_rate > 1% for 10m OR p95 > 500ms for 15m -> automatic rollback to fallback model + paging to eng.
devon-ml: Also request a shadow run comparing outputs for quantization/regression checks. I'll run eval during the canary window and post diffs.
liam-sre: Ops coverage: I can be on duty Thu 02:45–05:00 UTC. Who else can monitor latency dashboards and autoscale events?
maria-cs: assigning liam-sre for ops. @kapil-eng please attach autoscale policy and tag the pool with `renewal-check`.
kapil-eng: Will configure autoscale policy now and post confirmation shortly.
capacity-bot: Autoscale policy applied to pool-5f3a: min_gpus=2, max_gpus=8, scale_threshold=75%, step=1, cooldown=300s.
anya-se: Draft runbook uploaded: https://docs.internal/runbooks/aegis-dedicated-bringup — please review and comment. I'll iterate Wed after feedback.
maria-cs: :thumbsup: Final ask for account team: share success criteria with the customer CSM and confirm acceptance window with AegisSoft. I'll DM josh-sales the summary.
liam-sre: Noted. I'll stand by at 02:45 UTC and watch p95/error dashboards + autoscale events.
devon-ml: I'll kick off the shadow eval at 02:30 UTC to have results before the canary starts.
anya-se: I'll add a short troubleshooting checklist (KV cache refill, token-bucket spikes, model fallback) in the runbook and mark critical checkpoints.
maria-cs: Thanks all — let's reconvene Wed 11:00 PT for a final preflight. Post any blockers here.
